curiosities: It plays PlayStation games on the original console's own processor, which runs its inputs and outputs.
For many in 2000 it was the cheapest way to watch DVDs.
With over 155 million sold, it is the best-selling home console ever.
Sony made it for nearly 13 years, until the end of 2012.
It launched in Japan on 4 March 2000.
Its processor, the Emotion Engine, runs at about 295 MHz; its graphics chip is the Graphics Synthesizer.
It has 32 MB of main memory.
The slim model of 2004 has the network adapter built in.
With the network adapter and hard drive, Final Fantasy XI played online on it.
The EyeToy camera of 2003 put players on screen.
Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas is its best-selling game.
